title: Release a trained computation with a deployment audit
hardware: CPU; device and network validation remain separate

stages.title: Trained artifact and adaptation provenance
stages.evidence: Stable objective oracle, actual pretraining, saved/reloaded base and changed-task update
stages.expected: PASS stage 1: independent objective gradient, genuine pretraining, checkpoint reload and changed-task adaptation
stages.diagnosis: Check objective reduction, target shape and checkpoint identity before altering the learning rate.

stages.title: Export and precision contract
stages.evidence: Six real serialized artifacts, independent output and integer arithmetic checks, calibration hashes and corruption rejection
stages.expected: PASS stage 2: six exported round trips, independent precision arithmetic, calibration provenance and corruption rejection
stages.diagnosis: Inspect weight axes, scale granularity, activation calibration and the actual restored artifact.

stages.title: Request timing and capacity evidence
stages.evidence: Validated JSON requests, completed batch timings, clipping reports and independently checked queue assumptions
stages.expected: PASS stage 3: real JSON request parity, timed batch requests, clipping, bad inputs and independent queue timelines
stages.diagnosis: Separate compute completion, request overhead and simulated queue delay; preserve units.

rubric: Identify the trained base and adaptation data using recorded hashes
Compare a stable objective and gradient with an independent reference
Reload actual exported artifacts across declared batch and precision policies
Keep calibration separate from evaluation and report activation clipping
Measure completion inside an explicit local request boundary
Explain simulated queue growth without claiming a real server load test
setupNote: Use the top folder of the extracted ZIP as the working directory. It contains requirements-cpu.txt and projects/deployment-audit. This project exercises an in-process CPU request boundary; real network and target-device measurements require separate runs.
